title: Write pipeline integration test in tests/test_pipeline_integration.py
description:
Create tests/test_pipeline_integration.py with pytest-based integration tests that verify persona injection, working-memory history flow, memory extraction, and the wired turn pipeline end-to-end. Tests must use mocks or stubs for external dependencies (provider calls, database) so no real services are required.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/core/steps.py (TurnContext, TurnStep, StepResult)
- chatbot/core/turn.py (TurnPipeline, build_default_pipeline — wired in task b.4)
- chatbot/api/chat.py (chat_router, ChatRequest, ChatResponse — wired in task b.5)
- chatbot/soul/persona_prompt.py (PersonaPromptAssembler, created by task b.1)
- chatbot/memory/working_memory.py (WorkingMemoryLoader, created by task b.3)
- chatbot/memory/extraction.py (MemoryExtractor, created by task b.2)
- tests/test_chat_e2e.py (existing test patterns, fixtures, TestClient usage — created in Phase G)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY tests/test_pipeline_integration.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Create tests/test_pipeline_integration.py with:
   - Module docstring: 'Integration tests for the wired turn pipeline (persona, working memory, extraction).'
   - Test class `TestPersonaInjection`:
     * test_persona_prompt_is_deterministic — same persona dict produces same prompt string.
     * test_persona_injected_into_context — a TurnContext with a persona dict results in persona text appearing in compiled_context after pipeline run.
   - Test class `TestWorkingMemoryFlow`:
     * test_history_bounded_by_max_turns — WorkingMemoryLoader with mock store respects max_turns.
     * test_history_injected_into_context — history loaded by Retrieve step appears in ctx.history and flows into compiled_context.
   - Test class `TestMemoryExtraction`:
     * test_extraction_produces_memories — MemoryExtractor with mock store returns list[dict] for a turn with content.
     * test_empty_turn_returns_empty — extract on empty provider_response returns empty list.
     * test_extraction_in_pipeline — ExtractMemory step populates ctx.extracted_memories.
   - Test class `TestWiredPipelineE2E`:
     * test_full_pipeline_with_persona_and_memory — builds a wired TurnPipeline (or mock-wired with test doubles), runs with a session_id and user_message, asserts all ctx fields populated: persona -> compiled_context, history -> history, provider_response -> provider_response, extraction -> extracted_memories.
     * test_step_results_recorded — asserts 6 StepResults after pipeline run.
   - All tests must use test doubles (unittest.mock.MagicMock/AsyncMock or manual stubs) for provider calls, database sessions, and any I/O. No real LLM calls, no real database connections.

2. Follow the existing test patterns in tests/test_chat_e2e.py (pytest fixtures, class organization, assertion style).

3. Ensure python -m py_compile tests/test_pipeline_integration.py passes.
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_pipeline_integration.py exists with TestPersonaInjection, TestWorkingMemoryFlow, TestMemoryExtraction, TestWiredPipelineE2E classes
All tests use mocks/stubs — no real provider calls or database connections
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any chatbot/ or abracapocus/ source file
call real LLM providers or establish real database connections in tests
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: use unittest.mock.MagicMock and AsyncMock for test doubles
use pytest fixtures for constructing test TurnContext and pipeline
forbidden: require Postgres, Redis, or external services
add integration tests requiring running servers
